note: native application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help
activity bar and bottom bar -- renders fixed operator icons: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
search viewlet header -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Search' heading and toolbar controls (refresh, clear, new editor, list, collapse)
search input controls -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: search box, case sensitive, whole word, regex toggles
search details toggle -- renders fixed operator control
search status message -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'No results found' or similar status text
editor tab bar chrome -- renders fixed operator controls: close, split, more; tab labels are user-named files and are subtracted
getting started page -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: product name, subtitle, categories (Start, Learn, Customize), and action buttons (New File, Go to File, Open Folder, etc.)
status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: remote indicator, SCM status, problems count, forwarded ports, notifications, screen reader mode
